description:
An addictive relaxing color sort game with challenges for sorting puzzle fans!
Welcome to Woody Sort, a simple and addictive color sorting puzzle. Your objective is to fill each tube with the same colored balls. It may sound easy, but there is a twist: You can't put a ball on top of another ball with a different color in different drinking bottles. Enjoy this offline color sorting game and a relaxing brain challenge! Move balls by placing them into different tubes! Relaxing brain game from the creators of the Brain Test brain teaser!

⭐THOUSANDS OF LEVELS⭐
➤ Go on a journey with a level map that spans over 1000s color sort levels. Balls come in different formations at each level in this color sorting game. Sorting and filling the tubes require analytic thinking and strategic planning.
➤ Move up and claim great progression rewards to customize the puzzle. Are you bored of classic water puzzle games and color sort games? Color Sorting is a fun and challenging ball game with a huge breakthrough in the gameplay of sorting games.

⭐RELAXING GAMEPLAY⭐
➤ Woody Sort features natural-looking graphics with wooden textures. Enjoy the ultimate zen experience of the game's beautiful rustic graphics. Also, take a fresh look at the color sort games genre with leaves, wooden signs, and shining particle effects. Play without the internet - our free game lets you explore new worlds offline.

⭐POWERFUL MECHANICS⭐
➤ Woody Sort provides all the necessary tools to help players complete every challenge. The reset button can restart a level that goes badly, or wrong moves can be undone with the undo booster. The game caters to all kinds of players with plenty of accessibility options.

⭐CLASSICS OF COLOR SORTING⭐
➤ Water or liquid game veterans will also find a place in Woody Sort, as we use the same sorting mechanics every player loves and enjoys. Tubes are ready for everyone to fill up! The game comes with refined, enhanced soda mechanics. Effortlessly switch the ball positions and match their color balls into tubes.

⭐ENJOY WITH FRIENDS⭐
➤ Leaderboards set the field for the players who are resilient and intelligent. Finish as much as you can to climb the ranks and show your name in the hall of fame.
➤ The weekly contests are another way of online competition. Play and collect as many stars as you can!

How cool is that, this is basically play-to-win!

⭐CUSTOMIZE YOUR GAME⭐
Use the new customization feature to configure bottles, balls, themes and plugs the way you want!

HOW TO PLAY:

* Tap on a tube to take out the top ball.
* Tap on another tube to move the taken-out ball there.
* Make your moves carefully to avoid getting stuck. Use the undo booster to cover mistakes.
* Use the add tube booster to get extra tubes to help you sort them easier.
* Pull the pin booster enables you to overcome challenging obstacles.
* Finish the level by making minimum moves to achieve three stars.

FEATURES:

* Colorful graphics.
* Relaxing and easy gameplay without restricting mechanics or time limits.
* Good brain exercise and relaxing bubble puzzle.
* Brain games and iq games are for improving the brain. You can play the best games offline.
* A variety of bonus levels provide different gameplay options and exciting rewards.
* Smooth controls. Easy tapping with color sort games.
* Fast animations. Flowing gameplay.
* It can be played with one finger.
* Safe for family play.
* No internet connection is required.
* Completely free to download and play
* One of the best games in the world. Free offline games and nice games.
